First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it’s a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Relaxed, 20-25 miles on trail.
Check
Look at the host’s website the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Kyle’s Bikes Waukee Wednesday Trail Ride group ride

Kyle’s Bikes Waukee Wednesday Trail Ride is a social group ride in Waukee, IA. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:00 pm from Kyle’s Bikes Waukee.

A social midweek ride that rolls from Kyle’s Waukee store straight onto the Raccoon River Valley Trail at 6:00 pm. It is relaxed, 20 to 25 miles. The shop lists it as new for 2026.
